results.snippet: In order to raise the bar for non-English QA, we are releasing a high-quality, human-labeled German QA dataset consisting of 13 722 questions, incl. a three-way annotated test set. The creation of GermanQuAD is inspired by insights from existing datasets as well as our labeling experience from several industry projects.
